title: Timestamp Format Guesser
description: Auto-detect timestamp formats: seconds, milliseconds, microseconds, nanoseconds, Excel, LDAP, etc.
inputHint: Supports multiple formats: Unix seconds/ms/μs/ns, Excel date, LDAP/FILETIME, etc.
toolInfo: Different systems and applications use different timestamp formats. Unix timestamps use 1970-01-01 as epoch, Excel uses 1899-12-30, and LDAP/Windows FILETIME uses 1601-01-01. This tool helps identify what time format an unknown numeric value might represent.
relativeNote: Relative value, cannot convert to absolute time
